patterns.hook_pattern: Custom hooks follow a pattern of returning state and actions with TypeScript interfaces
patterns.state_pattern: Each CRUD page uses 8-10 useState hooks: isLoading, error, isModalOpen, isSaving, editingItem, formData, formError, deleteTarget, isDeleting
patterns.handler_pattern: Handlers follow try/catch pattern with loading state management and error handling
patterns.typescript_pattern: All hooks are strongly typed with explicit interfaces for state and actions

existing_implementations.description: Found 20 CRUD pages with identical state management patterns across dashboard and admin sections
